mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Infestation Sage: "When this creature dies, create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature
# token with flying."
# M21 Deathbloom Thallid's verified "When this creature dies, create a 1/1 green Saproling
# creature token." (B2a-deathbloom-thallid) with the token a 1/1 Insect (ZNR Scute Swarm's Insect),
# black and green, with flying (M21 Archfiend's Vessel's token keyword).
dies = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Insect',
            type_line='Creature — Insect',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Insect',),
            power=QConst(value=1),
            toughness=QConst(value=1),
            keywords=(Keyword.FLYING,),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('B', 'G'),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [dies, *compiled]
